scripts.dev: corepack pnpm db:setup && concurrently -k -n ui,api "corepack pnpm dev:ui" "corepack pnpm dev:api"
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --env local --local
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute DB --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --env local --local --file worker/seed.sql
scripts.db:setup: corepack pnpm db:migrate && corepack pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute DB --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --env local --local --file worker/reset.sql && corepack pnpm db:setup
scripts.db:import-preview:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config worker/wrangler.import-preview.jsonc --env import_preview --local --persist-to worker/.wrangler/import-preview
scripts.db:import-preview:prepare: pnpm db:import-preview:migrate && wrangler d1 execute DB --config worker/wrangler.import-preview.jsonc --env import_preview --local --persist-to worker/.wrangler/import-preview --file worker/import-preview-members.sql
scripts.dev:import-preview: pnpm db:import-preview:prepare && concurrently -k -n ui,api "pnpm dev:import-preview:ui" "pnpm dev:import-preview:api"
